name: Menubar
description: Radix Menubar: a horizontal row of menus that share focus and open on hover once one is open.
intent: A persistent application menu bar, in the desktop-software sense.

keyboard: Arrow keys — move within a menu
notes: The whole bar is one tab stop with roving focus.
This pattern is unfamiliar on the web. Only use it where the desktop metaphor is genuinely expected.

usage: Desktop-class applications — editors, IDEs, design tools
When users expect File, Edit, View
doNotUse: A typical web application — a toolbar with ui:dropdown-menu is lighter and more familiar

agentRules: Keep top-level items to about five.
Not suitable for narrow layouts — provide an alternative.
